posts.subject: Chubbysablo voice abuse [Knife]
posts.bodyHtml:
Hi,


I just played on knife and the player 'Chubbysablo' was blatantly voice abusing.


Download of demo:

Hi Knawledge,


thanks for your submission. I reviewed the demo but unfortunately the given evidence is not enough to really punish the user. He didn't spam too much/often; normally he'd be muted till the end of the round, banning him would be exaggerated imo. However if any admin sees him doing that again the punishment will be more strict as it's not his first time.


Also when you notice someone voice spamming, and there's no admin available you can always mute players by yourself in the options so you don't have to endure their behaviour.


Best regards


BlackFire
